changes.description: Show me how builds the division up instead of showing it finished. The practitioner: "the show me how it works does not really make sense from a step by step perspective." It did not: one step followed a single house to its nearest pump, and the next showed every dividing line and every cell at once, so the construction happened between two steps and was described rather than drawn. Now two pumps and the one line between them, then the third added and the lines meeting. Both drawn by `voronoi` itself, on two pumps and then three.
